description: Cs₈Na₄Ho₃YCl₂₄ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. There are four inequivalent Cs sites. In the first Cs site, Cs is bonded to twelve Cl atoms to form CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, and faces with four HoCl₆ octahedra. All Cs-Cl bond lengths are 3.86 Å. In the second Cs site, Cs is bonded to twelve Cl atoms to form CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra,  a faceface with one YCl₆ octahedra, faces with three equivalent HoCl₆ octahedra, and faces with four NaCl₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (3.85 Å) and nine longer (3.86 Å) Cs-Cl bond lengths. In the third Cs site, Cs is bonded to twelve Cl atoms to form CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra,  a faceface with one HoCl₆ octahedra, faces with three equivalent YCl₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (3.85 Å) and nine longer (3.86 Å) Cs-Cl bond lengths. In the fourth Cs site, Cs is bonded to twelve Cl atoms to form CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four NaCl₆ octahedra, and faces with four HoCl₆ octahedra. All Cs-Cl bond lengths are 3.86 Å. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six HoCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.82 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent HoCl₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent YCl₆ octahedra, and faces with eight CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are three shorter (2.80 Å) and three longer (2.82 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Ho sites. In the first Ho site, Ho is bonded to six Cl atoms to form HoCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ho-Cl bond lengths are 2.63 Å. In the second Ho site, Ho is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form HoCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ho-Cl bond lengths are 2.63 Å. Y is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form YCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Y-Cl bond lengths are 2.65 Å. There are four inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four Cs, one Na, and one Ho atom. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four Cs, one Na, and one Ho atom. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four Cs, one Na, and one Y atom. In the fourth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four Cs, one Na, and one Ho atom.
